fields.promptBlocks/0/text: For each proposal, say "yes" or "no" and justify.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/2: Traffic reduction by 25%, with traffic costs of 240k/month, 1 week
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/3: Screen 900 ms now, with 3x growth will become 2.6 s, 1 week
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 — no, within the "fast" category, there will be no behavioral effect. 2 — yes, moving from "irritation" to "expectation". 3 — yes, saving ~720k/year for a week of work, pays off in money regardless of perception. 4 — yes, a growing problem, cheaper now. Technique: perception category, behavioral effect, money, growth — four grounds, any one is sufficient.
